biggest_catch: The original TikTok Creator Fund ended on 2023-12-16 and was replaced by a different program (now the Creator Rewards Program) — the Fund itself is dead and cannot be joined.
catches: TikTok ended the original Creator Fund in the US, UK, France, and Germany on December 16, 2023; it was replaced first by the Creativity Program and then by the Creator Rewards Program.

The current Creator Rewards Program is a separate program with its own eligibility (10,000 followers, 100,000 video views in 30 days, 18+, personal account, eligible country) and pays by formula — it is not the Creator Fund under a new name.
Converting the dead Fund into the current program would misdescribe both; per verification rules the dead program is rejected rather than converted.

c1.evidence: TikTok is real, but the named Creator Fund program is closed and not currently available.

c2.evidence: No official TikTok page exists for joining the original Creator Fund; TikTok's support pages document only its successor programs.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee applies; irrelevant, since the program is closed.

c4.evidence: No official payout figure can exist for a closed program; payout_quote is null.

eligibility: Not applicable — the original Creator Fund is closed and cannot be joined.
notes: Verified against TikTok's official support page for the Creator Rewards Program (support.tiktok.com). The old Fund's end (2023-12-16) and its replacement path are documented on TikTok's own support pages; no official page for joining the original Fund exists because it is closed.

s1.note: The route cannot be joined by anyone — the program is closed.

s2.note: The named program's terms are no longer live; only its successor's terms exist.

s3.note: No payout timing exists for a closed program.

s4.note: No weasel words — the program is simply closed.

s5.note: No official page exists for the named Fund; the cited URL covers only the successor Creator Rewards Program.

s6.note: No steps are possible — the program cannot be joined.

s7.note: TikTok support pages read 2026-09-23 cover only the successor Creator Rewards Program, not the named Fund.

timing: The named Creator Fund is closed; it cannot be joined.
